verified_facts.text: Host Hotels & Resorts bought the property and rebranded it as The Ritz-Carlton O’ahu, Turtle Bay in 2024.
verified_facts.excerpt: Host Hotels & Resorts, Inc. bought and rebranded the property as The Ritz-Carlton O’ahu, Turtle Bay in 2024.

verified_facts.text: A hotel opened on the site in 1972 as Del Webb’s Kuilima Resort Hotel & Country Club.
verified_facts.excerpt: In 1972, a hotel was opened as Del Webb’s Kuilima Resort Hotel & Country Club.

verified_facts.text: The Ocean Bungalows are steps from the beach and have a private pool, host service and luxe amenities.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Ocean Bungalows are steps from the beach, with a private pool, host service and luxe amenities

verified_facts.text: The Ocean Bungalow pool is a private Tranquility Pool exclusively for Ocean Bungalow guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: Exclusively for Ocean Bungalow guests, this private Tranquility Pool offers a peaceful retreat surrounded by lush, tropical gardens and uninterrupted views of the shimmering ocean.

verified_facts.text: The Ali‘i Suite is the most expansive accommodation at the hotel.

verified_facts.text: The Ocean Villas are steps from the main resort and have a full kitchen.

verified_facts.text: Interior designer Dianna Wong used organic fabrics, natural hardwoods and hand-woven carpets in the rooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: interior designer Dianna Wong chose to incorporate organic fabrics, natural hardwoods, and hand-woven carpets in the rooms.

verified_facts.text: The Ritz-Carlton Club offers private oceanfront lounge access, daily culinary presentations and concierge service.
verified_facts.excerpt: Unlock an extension of your oasis with private oceanfront lounge access, daily culinary presentations, concierge service and activities.

verified_facts.text: Beach House by Roy Yamaguchi is at Kuilima Cove and serves family-favorite dishes created by chef Roy Yamaguchi.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located at Kuilima Cove, savor welcoming, family-favorite dishes created by Hawai‘i’s famed chef Roy Yamaguchi, inspired by memories of beachside gatherings.

verified_facts.text: Paniolo, A Hawaiian Cowboy Lūʻau is a weekly dinner show at the resort's Stables.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set against the ocean backdrop at our horse Stables, celebrate Hawai‘i’s rich ranching and cowboy heritage at our weekly dinner show.

verified_facts.text: The resort's Kuilima Farm grows many of the same fruits and vegetables that were cultivated in the traditional ahupua’a land division.
verified_facts.excerpt: Today, the resort’s Kuilima Farm grows many of the same fruits and vegetables that were cultivated as part of the traditional ahupua’a.

verified_facts.text: The Nalu Spa is oceanside and has open-air treatment rooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: Open-air treatment rooms allow the birdsong and breeze to flow through at the oceanside Nalu Spa

verified_facts.text: The Keiki Pool has two water slides.
verified_facts.excerpt: Home to two water slides, the Keiki Pool is where kids of all ages want to be.

verified_facts.text: The Adult Pool is an infinity-style pool with a hot tub and in-water loungers.
verified_facts.excerpt: This infinity-style pool in our Oahu resort spa features a hot tub, in-water loungers, and endless ocean views.

verified_facts.text: Seven secluded beaches are within walking distance of the resort.

verified_facts.text: A kayak Turtle Tour crosses Kawela Bay's calm waters to spot marine life, including honu (Hawaiian green sea turtles).
